Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "The Gamecock" has the older director. The data gathered in the previous step clearly showed Pasquale Festa Campanile was born in 1927 and Bill Rebane was born in 1937. Since 1927 is earlier than 1937, Pasquale Festa Campanile is older. The Planner failed to perform the correct chronological comparison (1927 < 1937) and reversed the logic, stating the 1927-born director was older by 10 years in the wrong direction (implying 1927 is later or misinterpreting "older" as "younger" in the final text, or simply making a calculation error). This matches the pattern in Example 5 where an agent retrieves correct data but draws a contradictory conclusion.
